name: io.github.mhidalgo-lab/relic-bridge
title: relic-bridge
description: Unofficial MCP server for New Relic: query NerdGraph and NRQL with your own User API key.

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: New Relic User API key. Without it the server only lists its tools.

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Account id that queries run against by default.

environmentVariables.name: RB_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Extra account ids this connection may query, comma-separated.

environmentVariables.name: RB_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tool allowlist, comma-separated tool names (default: every read-only tool).
